detailed_description: The Word to HTML converter turns a .docx file into browser-rendered HTML using mammoth. You can drop or choose a DOCX file, preview the converted HTML, switch to the HTML code view, copy the generated markup, or download a single .html file. The output is sanitized before display and is best for extracting readable document content with basic structure such as headings, paragraphs, lists, links, and simple formatting. Complex Word layouts, embedded objects, revision marks, custom style mapping, and multi-file asset archives may not be preserved.
usage_steps: Drop a .docx file onto the upload area or choose one from your device
Wait while the browser converts the document with mammoth
Switch to code view if you want to inspect the generated markup
Copy the HTML or download it as a single .html file
usage_examples: Convert a DOCX draft into HTML for quick review in a CMS editor
Extract readable HTML from a simple Word handout
Copy generated markup from a document outline into a web page draft
Download a single HTML file from a DOCX note for local editing

faqs.question: Is all formatting preserved?
faqs.answer: Basic formatting like headings, bold, italic, and lists are preserved. Complex layouts may not convert perfectly.

faqs.question: Can I edit the HTML?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can copy the HTML code and edit it in any text editor or HTML editor.
